title: Mere Bacche Palat
body:
haye mere raaj dulaare
haye meri aankhon ke taare
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke kehti thi muslim ki bewa
mere bacche palat kar na aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh paayi na phir unka chehra
mere bacche palat kar na aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
meri saansein ukhadti hai har dam
aur nikalta hai har dam mera dam
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
unka na jaane kya haal hoga
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
khwaab jis din se maine ye dekha
khoon mein tar hai dono ka kurta
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
moo ko aata hai mera kaleja
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri aaghosh bharti hai aahein
dhoondti hai unhe meri baahein
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
dil mein chubta hai har waqt naiza
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
chain bacchon ke bin kaise aaye
ab sukoon maamta kaise paayein
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
hai nigahon mein meri andhera
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khabar jab se mai ne suni hai
unka kufe mein koi nahi hai
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
dard ka dil pe chalta hai aara
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko qismat ne ye din dikhaya
waqt ne ye sitam mujhpe dhaaya
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
uth gaya sar se waali ka saaya
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne baba se dono bichad kar
kha rahe honge dar dar ki thokar
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
dil tadapta hai is gham se mera
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye waiz wo dukhiyari maadar
ay ali ro ke kehti thi aksar
mere noor e nazar mere lakhte jigar
jaa ke pardes phir aaye na laut kar
leke apne dulaaron ka kurta
mere bacche palat...
ro ke kehti thi...
author: Waiz Sultanpuri
